item.title: Re: SCP Idea (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Allllrighty! Time to do some answering!

+ Legggggoo!
- Done reading?

So,

How would a family on the ground utilize a wormhole in a cloud (as they're very high up?)

So, here's my two cents on this. I dont think that the family would utilize the cloud, but they would definitely need a way to find out of the existence of its anomalous properties.

Lets assume, from a story standpoint, that a few generations ago in the families, somebodies Uncle or something was flying high in either a personal plane, helicopter, or something along those lines. They find a "void in the sky", and investigate by going towards it. Next thing they know, they're on the other side of the world. Now that would be a story that you tell the fuck out of to your family, aye? But not something that people outside of the family would spread much, as it just sounds pure crazy.

Uncle or whatever relative is chosen gets their way safely back home, where they tell the story.

Now, as of right now, I'm not entirely sure why they would choose to move under the cloud off of that.

I assume one of the family members decides to go back to that exact spot, and finds the cloud again. They write down a more specific location of it, and then are later on able to sometimes recognize it in the sky. Combined with a few family experiences, i feel that its something that would be passed down through the generations as a story to tell kids.

This kind of thing would happen to both families, i think.

Next question!

More importantly, what’s the story? What do you want to say about these families?

I want to tell through interviews how the knowledge of at least one anomalous object in their lives has impacted each of the individual family members. I want to give each of the family members a character; a personality. I want to have them each have their own little stories to tell about their life under the cloud.

I feel that with enough character development given to each of these characters, its entirely possible that i can have readers grow at least somewhat attached to the families, and their small, peculiar lives.

item.title: SCP Idea (Seeking Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article

Elevator Pitch: Essentially a wormhole disguised as a cloud as creation possibly from a GOI (yet to be decided.) The two clouds that obviously allow you to teleport to eachother are antipodal to eachother. Edit lmao: Looking at the wormhole from the ground, it appears to look like a normal cloud. However, viewed from above, it looks more akin to the image i have hopefully attached. They are static in the sky.

Central Narrative: This SCP could be an explanation for tons of aeronautical mishaps. There are two families living in houses directly underneath both of the clouds, however they are both aware of the anomalous properties of the cloud. The families contain a father, mother, two children of indeterminent gender, and a dog. They are likely in contact with eachother, and despite the similarities, are very different people. This is another aspect that I plan to flesh out a lot more (interview logs, experiments, etc). edit: Due to the fact that these 'wormholes' were likely created by someone or something sentient, they were probably not meant to be discovered by people! i imagine these came into existence before the first planes were flown, and so all they needed to do was disguise the lower part of the wormhole to appear as a cloud to the naked eye.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: It is based around a cloud, which is something that not many scips do. It also could be used to explain possible events in history, or something along those lines. The idea of a wormhole has been done before, but i imagine that this is something i can give more personality.

Additional Notes: This is in somewhat early development! i have a lot of ideas and their base, although there is still some further fleshing out to do.
